messages:
Olivia Chen: quick FYI, noticed an odd jump in routed requests for tenant `acme-inc` right after we enabled per-tenant routing at 06:07. dashboard: https://dash/reports/rt-945
Carl Park: saw that too. qps to /v1/generate doubled for acme-inc around 06:10. not seeing same pattern for other tenants.
Samir Nair: did we change quota calculation? rollout note said only routing changes, but if routing->quota ordering changed, quota service might be attributing differently.
June: rollout snippet: "proxy now attaches x-tenant-bucket and routes to tenant-specific pool; batching enabled per-tenant". I can paste the PR if helpful.
Tracey: we didn't touch quota calc code, but proxy started assigning tenant-buckets before the authn step. so quota lookup might be using the bucket id instead of original project key.
Olivia Chen: here's the quick query I ran: ```kql
requests | where path startswith "/v1/" and tenant=="acme-inc" | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1m)
``` shows spike from 06:10-06:14. linked to the feature flip.
Carl Park: mitigation plan: flip per-tenant sticky routing OFF for acme-inc (per-tenant flag) and observe. can do without full rollback.
June: toggled routing.fallback.acme-inc -> ON (console flag). infra-bot accepted the flag change.
infra-bot: feature flag change accepted (id:ff-4821), applied to proxy pool 3/3.
Tracey: note: falling back to global routing will remove per-tenant batching, cost increases for that tenant but should restore original quota attribution.
Samir Nair: long-term fixes: (A) reorder so quota service is consulted before tenant routing OR (B) preserve original project key in a header like `x-original-project` forwarded to quota service. I prefer B to minimize perf impact.
Olivia Chen: agree B is lower risk. Also add telemetry: tag routing_decision in token-level logs so quota and billing can correlate.
Carl Park: I can add an alert: if routed_qps / baseline_qps > 1.5 for >5m after a routing change, page eng-platform. simple anomaly detector.
June: spike dropping now after flag flip :relieved:. will put a short incident note in #incidents with timestamps and dashboard links.
Samir Nair: i'll prototype `x-original-project` in staging today and add `auth.proxy.routing_path` as a log tag. want a staging canary tomorrow before resuming rollout.
Tracey: add unit tests around header pass-through and an integration test ensuring quota lookup uses original project when present.
Olivia Chen: timeline sounds good. also can we add a lightweight console card: "routing: tenant vs global by tenant"? product wants to watch rollouts.
Carl Park: will update docs in /docs/rollouts/authz-routing with per-tenant toggle instructions and the new alert rule.
June: noted. i'll also add runbook step: if tenant sees QPS > baseline*1.5, flip fallback flag and notify stakeholders.
Olivia Chen: thanks all. follow-up: send a short note to `acme-inc` ops explaining temporary behaviour and that we're investigating.
infra-bot: metric emit: routing.decisions.tag added, feature-flag change logged (ff-4821).
Tracey: postmortem TODOs: 1) root cause writeup, 2) implement x-original-project header, 3) telemetry dashboard card, 4) update rollouts doc and runbook. Assign owners?
Samir Nair: I'll own header + tests. Carl take alerts/docs. June handle runbook & incident note. Olivia coordinate stakeholder comms.
Olivia Chen: great, thanks everyone.
